title: Russian White Fish Stew
description: A comforting and cultured Russian dish featuring white fish fillets, this stew is dense and satisfying, made with satvik-friendly ingredients. It is a traditional recipe that has been passed down through generations.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the chopped onions, carrots, and potatoes, and saute over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add the vegetable broth, dried dill, salt, and black pepper to the pot, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 10 minutes.
Add the white fish fillets to the pot, and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the lemon juice and chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes for a hearty meal.
